observation: Fresh main accepted any string as currentRunId even though the referenced RunStore only accepts durable identities matching ^run-[A-Za-z0-9-]+$. A tampered mission could therefore carry an impossible run reference and fail later inside runner.get() instead of failing closed at the mission read boundary.
changes: Validate non-null currentRunId values against the existing durable RunStore identity contract.
Publish the same run-id reference pattern in Autonomous Mission v0.1.
Add a focused cross-contract regression that preserves valid lowercase run prefixes and rejects impossible references.
